stories.title: Dans la douleur, l'équipe de Suisse bat la Slovénie et poursuit son sans-faute

en.title: Switzerland's team beats Slovenia in difficult fashion and continues unbeaten run
en.summary: Switzerland defeated Slovenia 2-1 in Lucerne to maintain their perfect record in Nations League B with three wins in three matches. Promotion to League A is within reach, possibly after their next match against North Macedonia.

stories.title: Ligue des nations - La Suisse continue son sans-faute en battant la Slovénie 2-1

en.title: Nations League - Switzerland continues unbeaten run by beating Slovenia 2-1
en.summary: Switzerland secured their third consecutive victory in Nations League B by defeating Slovenia 2-1 in Lucerne. Dan Ndoye scored a goal in the 38th minute in the victory.

stories.title: Marine Le Pen maintient "totalement" sa "confiance" à Jordan Bardella, accusé d'écrits antisémites

en.title: Marine Le Pen maintains "completely" her "confidence" in Jordan Bardella, accused of antisemitic writings
en.summary: Far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen expressed continued confidence in Jordan Bardella, her party's president, who faces accusations of writing antisemitic messages in 2013, which he denies.

stories.title: L'armée fédérale éthiopienne annonce être entrée dans la capitale du Tigré

en.title: Ethiopian federal army announces it has entered the capital of Tigray
en.summary: Ethiopian federal troops entered Mekele, the capital of Tigray region, on Saturday as regional rebel forces withdrew from the city. The federal army has been fighting the regional authorities since September 23.

stories.title: Marine Le Pen garde «totalement confiance» en Jordan Bardella, malgré l'affaire des écrits antisémites

en.title: Marine Le Pen maintains "total confidence" in Jordan Bardella despite antisemitic writings affair
en.summary: Marine Le Pen reiterated her support for Jordan Bardella, the National Rally party leader, who faces accusations of writing antisemitic messages in 2013. This marks her first public response since the allegations were authenticated and published.

stories.title: En Ethiopie, l'armée fédérale est entrée dans Mekele, la capitale du Tigré désertée par les autorités rebelles

en.title: In Ethiopia, federal army enters Mekele, Tigray capital abandoned by rebel authorities
en.summary: Ethiopian federal troops entered Mekele, the capital of the Tigray region, which had been largely abandoned by rebel regional forces. This occurred during renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia that resumed after months of tensions.

stories.title: Une manif à Genève exige de la Suisse des sanctions contre Israël

en.title: Demonstration in Geneva demands Switzerland impose sanctions against Israel
en.summary: About 1,500 protesters gathered in Geneva calling for Switzerland to establish military, energy, and commercial embargoes against Israel. The demonstration occurred three years after the October 7 attacks and subsequent military operations in Gaza.

stories.title: Les Vert-e-s valident la double candidature de Vassilis Venizelos et Rebecca Joly pour l'élection au Conseil d'Etat vaudois

en.title: The Greens validate the dual candidacy of Vassilis Venizelos and Rebecca Joly for the Vaud State Council election
en.summary: The Green Party officially nominated Vassilis Venizelos and Rebecca Joly as candidates for the February election to the Vaud State Council. The nominations were approved during an extraordinary party congress held in Lausanne.

stories.title: 1500 manifestants rassemblés à Genève en soutien aux Palestiniens exigent des sanctions suisses contre Israël

en.title: 1500 Protesters Gathered in Geneva in Support of Palestinians Demand Swiss Sanctions Against Israel
en.summary: The Palestine Emergency Collective organized a rally of 1500 people in Geneva, calling for Swiss military, energy, and commercial embargoes against Israel.

stories.title: Les Vert-e-s valident un duo Venizelos-Joly pour l'élection au Conseil d'Etat vaudois

en.title: Greens validate Venizelos-Joly duo for Vaud State Council election
en.summary: The Vaud environmental minister Vassilis Venizelos and the cantonal Green party president Rebecca Joly have been officially nominated as a slate for the February election to the Vaud State Council.

stories.title: Le Ministère public valaisan ordonne une expertise psychiatrique de Jacques Moretti, accusé de violences conjugales

en.title: Valais public prosecutor orders psychiatric evaluation of Jacques Moretti, accused of domestic violence
en.summary: Jacques Moretti, a restaurant owner held in provisional detention for two months and suspected of assaulting his wife, has been ordered by the Valais public prosecutor to undergo psychiatric evaluation.

stories.title: Jacques Moretti doit se soumettre à une expertise psychiatrique

en.title: Jacques Moretti must undergo psychiatric assessment
en.summary: Jacques Moretti, boss of Constellation, is in provisional detention on suspicion of violence against his wife and is undergoing psychiatric evaluation. The assessment is expected to delay his release from prison.

stories.title: «Cyberangriffe sind zu einer industriellen Kriminalität geworden»: Der Axa-Chef Thomas Buberl warnt vor KI-gesteuerten Hacker-Attacken

en.title: "Cyberattacks have become industrial crime": Axa CEO Thomas Buberl warns of AI-driven hacker attacks
en.summary: The insurance manager compares AI-related risks to a pandemic and criticizes the German government's reform efforts as irresponsible.

stories.title: Enttäuschung in Bern über die unnachgiebige Haltung der Schweizerischen Nationalbank

en.title: Disappointment in Bern Over Swiss National Bank's Unyielding Position
en.summary: The Swiss National Bank defended its cautious dividend distribution policy in negotiations with the Federal Finance Department, agreeing only to minimal changes.

stories.title: Neue KI-Agenten sehen so herzig aus wie Teddybären – und wollen Zugang zu Ihren persönlichsten Daten

en.title: New AI Agents Look as Cute as Teddy Bears – and Want Access to Your Most Personal Data
en.summary: Mark Zuckerberg's Meta leads in personal AI agents, though questions remain about whether users should allow Meta to organize their daily activities.

stories.title: Kriegsangst und russische Agenten: So versucht der Kreml die Wahlen in Lettland zu beeinflussen

en.title: War fears and Russian agents: How the Kremlin tries to influence elections in Latvia
en.summary: Russia has influenced Latvian politics since the 1990s, and pro-Russian parties are competing in Saturday's elections. The report examines whether these parties will gain significant support.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Wir haben es nicht mit KI-Systemen zu tun, die wie in einem Film den Wunsch haben, die Menschheit zu zerstören»

en.title: INTERVIEW - "We are not dealing with AI systems that, as in a movie, have the desire to destroy humanity"
en.summary: Artificial intelligence researcher Melanie Mitchell discusses how attributing human-like intentions to AI systems is misguided, while acknowledging that real risks exist with AI technology.
